summary: No single arm or combination improves both Validation and Test on at least two anchors with a stable, non-trivial effect. The strongest result is a Lipophilicity-specific combo (chem8+multicontrib): five runs, mean Test RMSE 0.5429 vs 0.5620 BASE, all five Test deltas negative. It is not promoted to LCRC-B because it is a single-dataset gain and regresses BACE, ESOL and HIV.

strongest_specialist.reason_not_lcirc_b: single dataset; BACE, ESOL and HIV regress; no multi-task consistency

strongest_single.reason_not_lcirc_b: Lipophilicity Test worsens on all three seeds (mean +0.0308); ESOL gain reverses at SCALE-M (+0.0157); no multi-task consistency

test_policy: DEVELOPMENT_TEST; Test never selected checkpoint, epoch, hyperparameter, width or seed
next_step: Carry combo_chem_contrib forward only as a Lipophilicity specialist; for a multi-task LCRC-B, seek a combination that preserves the Lipophilicity gain without regressing BACE/ESOL/HIV.
